powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output '=== POWER STATES ==='; powercfg /a; Write-Output '=== TEAMVIEWER WOL-RELATED CONFIG NAMES ==='; $paths=@('HKLM:\SOFTWARE\TeamViewer','HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\TeamViewer'); foreach($p in $paths){ if(Test-Path $p){ Write-Output ('KEY=' + $p); $obj=Get-ItemProperty $p; $obj.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object {$_.Name -match 'Wake|WOL|Lan|LAN'} | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ($_.Name + '=' + [string]$_.Value) } } }; Write-Output '=== IPv4/GATEWAY
